todays_goal: Make TacticLab's coaching controls function visibly before adding any new feature.

lessons.subject: computer_science
lessons.unit_title: Creative Technology and AI Builder Lab
lessons.previous_learning: TacticLab Coach Mode defined team width, defensive line, attack style, pressing, save, and reset. Today requires visible functional verification before feature expansion.
lessons.course_context: Product-quality testing and behavior repair in a live vibe-coded application.
learning_objectives: Test one behavior at a time.
Protect core functionality before adding features.
lessons.why_it_matters: Real builders make products reliable, not just feature-rich.

vocabulary.definition: run the same test again after a change

lessons.written_instruction: Laptop only. Do not add new features until Width, Defensive Line, Attack Style, Pressing, Save, and Reset pass visible acceptance tests.

worked_examples.title: Bug report
worked_examples.problem: Width says WIDE but players do not move.
worked_examples.solution: EXPECTED: players spread horizontally. ACTUAL: no visible change. STEPS: click Wide. RETEST after fix.
worked_examples.explanation: A precise report gives the coding agent enough information to fix the right behavior.

guided_practice.prompt: Put six acceptance tests on the whiteboard and test Width first.

exit_ticket.prompt: Demo every passing control and explain the one hardest bug you fixed.
exit_ticket.answer: Live functional demonstration and concise bug explanation.

lessons.voice_prompt: Laptop only. Keep a six-item acceptance checklist on the whiteboard. Test one control at a time. When a test fails, collect EXPECTED, ACTUAL, STEPS, RETEST. Do not explain programming theory unless Atticus asks. Do not take over the build.
lessons.teacher_notes: No new feature until core controls pass.
